ns2:course.label: Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: (CHIN 399) Lectures, seminars, and practical work in Chinese language, literature, and civilization and in other academic areas appropriate to the student's course of study. 0 to 16 undergraduate hours; 0 graduate hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 32 hours per academic year. Prerequisite: Junior standing and a GPA of 2.5.
